projects.name: Companion Deck
projects.summary: Turns an Android tablet into a touch control surface for a Windows PC: now-playing with artwork, a per-app volume mixer, live temperatures and frame rate, a game and app launcher, a soundboard, and calendars.
details: Detects what each PC and tablet can do and shows only that, so the same app works across laptops, desktops and tablets instead of being built around one machine.
Real frame rates in any game on any graphics card, read from Windows' own event tracing, with CPU temperature and fans from the sensor chips.
A .NET 8 agent on the PC talks to a thin Kotlin shell around a web interface on the tablet, over the USB cable with a Wi-Fi fallback.
One installer for Windows that includes everything it needs, and a signed Android app. It runs on Android 5 and newer, down to a 1 GB tablet.
Built with the help of AI, working under my direction. I made the decisions, tested it on real hardware, and am responsible for the result.
